summary: Applied current public docs to the receipt-bound evaluation gate: HF generation/cache/backend choices and PyTorch reproducibility/timing semantics must be recorded as evidence identity, not just prose.

sources.used_for: generation/cache knobs must be explicit in trace and verdict identity
cache implementation is part of decode behavior and must stay dynamic for this trace lane
attention backend identity is an explicit runtime surface that can change behavior
determinism/reproducibility has release/platform/device caveats, motivating tool/evidence hashes
timing evidence must declare clock/synchronization semantics separately from capture elapsed time

decision: Add a receipt object and selector-entry gate instead of another status registry. A selector run must be linked to the exact accepted NPZ/provenance/verifier/evaluator hashes.
